intent.problem_statement: Implement Modul 1 (The Audit Motor) as high-value lead capture using Insites API, split-strategy report, and cinematic storyteller UX.
success_metrics: Audit results in strictly less than 120s
Perceived value of Red Flag report by craftsmen/bakers
Seamless transition from Lead-Input to Storyteller

constraints.performance_requirements: Fast status polling (< 2s interval) without hitting Insites rate limits.
limitations: Sync-dependent report (No local data edit in Modul 1)

logic_flows: Report Render -> JSON Parse -> Heuristic Filter

decisions.resolution: Option B (Simulierter Flow) + Hybrid-Input. Die Storyteller-Karten laufen in einer Zeit-Schleife, Firmenname/Logo werden dynamisch nachgeladen.

decisions.issue: Logic of 'Red Flag' Extraction: Pedant vs. Pragmatiker
decisions.resolution: Option A (Hardcoded Rules) für Modul 1. Schnelle, deterministische Python-Heuristik für den Erst-Report.
Option A (Ehrliche Kommunikation). Wenn kein Audit möglich ist, direkt zur manuellen Datenpflege (Modul 2) leiten.
Option B (Teaser-Flow). Sofortiger Teil-Report, volle Details gegen E-Mail. UX-Transition via Clean Fade.
